title: Trump administration deported US citizen to Mexico, DoJ admits in court
summary_full: Brian Morales García of Texas seeks damages after he was wrongly identified as undocumented in case White House wants droppedThe Trump administration recently admitted in federal court that it deported a US citizen to Mexico after American authorities incorrectly concluded he was an undocumented immigrant.Attorneys for the US justice department made that admission on Friday while requesting the dismissal of a lawsuit for damages that the deported man – Brian José Morales García of Austin, Texas – has been pursuing against the federal government.
